analysis:
The only change in this PR is a documentation edit at docs/architecture/inference.md head lines 2966-2970. It adds that the cluster control leader's re-plan and re-adopt after a worker update waits until both Macs report the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild), and links to the pair's coordinated update in provider/cluster-always-on.md. The two supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 1645-2025 and 2026-2464) that do not include the changed hunk. They cover the scheduler, deadline admission, MTP, sampling, reasoning-parser, and tool-call documentation, and none of that is modified. The patch excerpt is complete.

I found no security-control change. There is no code, no config, and no change to the cache, attestation, authorization, or encryption behavior. T-041 (prefix-cache oracle and at-rest artifacts) and the other threat entries are unaffected.

The documentation describes a cluster-update sequencing control in code I cannot see (ClusterService.checkForUpdate, ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild). I could not verify it, and no threat-model entry covers the cluster boundary. Whether the described restart sequencing, its 600 s wait, or the version-matching check has any security impact would have to be judged on the code-bearing portions of the PR, if there are any. The documentation change alone introduces no regression.
